d:
Enjoy The Evergreen Kannada Lyrical Song “Raagavo Anuragavo” From The Classic Movie Yarivanu, Featuring The Legendary Dr. Rajkumar And Roopa Devi. Music Composed By The Iconic Duo Rajan-Nagendra.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Timeless Melody, Beautiful Lyrics And Unforgettable Performances. A Classic Kannada Song For All Music Lovers And Fans Of Dr. Rajkumar.
Directed by: Dorai-Bhagawan
Produced by: Parvathamma Rajkumar
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Puneeth Rajkumar, Roopa Devi, B. Saroja Devi, Srinath, Hema Choudhary
Music Director: Rajan-Nagendra
